title: Sounds all around us
examples: Can you show me how sound travels?

explain.say: Say sound is made by something shaking.
Say when things shake they make vibrations.
Say some sounds are very loud and some are quiet.
Say some sounds are high like a tiny bell ringing.
Say some sounds are low like a big truck driving by.
Say when you clap your hands they vibrate and make sound.

faq.q: How does sound get from one place to another?
faq.a: Sound travels in waves through the air or solids. These waves carry energy, not the sound itself.
asks: Does sound need air to move?

faq.a: No, vibrations can be very small making quiet sounds. Big vibrations make loud sounds.
asks: Does the size of the shake matter?

faq.q: What makes a high sound sound different?
faq.a: High sounds come from fast, small vibrations. Think of a tiny whistle making fast shakes.

faq.q: Can I make sound without shaking anything?
faq.a: No, all sounds we hear come from some kind of vibration. Something must shake to make sound.

faq.q: Is the loudness related to the strength of the shake?
faq.a: Yes, a stronger shake creates bigger vibrations, which makes a louder sound. A weak shake makes a quiet sound.
asks: Does strong shaking mean loud sound?

facts: Loudness is related to the size of the vibrations.
Pitch is related to how fast the vibrations are.

quiz.say: A tuning fork vibrates to make a clear sound. This vibration is an example of:
quiz.why: Vibrations are the shaking that creates all sounds.

wrong.0: Pitch describes if the sound is high or low.
wrong.1: A wave is what travels, but vibration is what starts it.
wrong.3: Loudness is how strong the sound is, not the cause.

quiz.say: A whisper is much quieter than a shout. This difference shows that sound can be:
quiz.why: A whisper has small vibrations, making it quiet.

wrong.0: Low refers to the pitch, not the volume.
wrong.1: Vibrating is what makes the sound, not the difference between quiet and loud.
wrong.3: High refers to the pitch, not the volume.

quiz.say: A piccolo makes a very high sound compared to a tuba. This difference is best described as a difference in:
quiz.why: The piccolo vibrates very fast, making a high pitch.

wrong.0: Vibration is the action; high/low describes the result.
wrong.2: Loudness is how strong the sound is, not its pitch.
wrong.3: Quiet relates to volume, not the pitch itself.
